$description: GENERATED closed-world token contract. Every public design token is enumerated here; a token not in this file is provably fabricated.

tokens.name: border.width.1
tokens.description: Standard border width for inputs, cards, and separators.

tokens.name: border.width.2
tokens.description: Emphasized border width for focus indicators and selected states.

tokens.name: color.accent.default
tokens.description: Primary brand action color for filled controls, selection indicators, and key highlights; AA-checked against color.text.on-accent.

tokens.name: color.accent.emphasis
tokens.description: Stronger accent for hover and active states of accent-filled controls; AA-checked against color.text.on-accent.

tokens.name: color.accent.muted
tokens.description: Soft accent tint for selected-item backgrounds and subtle highlights. Never a text color.

tokens.name: color.border.default
tokens.description: Standard border for inputs, cards, and separators on light surfaces.

tokens.name: color.border.focus
tokens.description: Focus-indicator border and outline color; used together with shadow.focus-ring.

tokens.name: color.border.muted
tokens.description: Hairline border for subtle separation — table rows, quiet card outlines.

tokens.name: color.border.strong
tokens.description: Higher-contrast border for hovered inputs and emphasized boundaries.

tokens.name: color.status.danger.border
tokens.description: Border for danger alerts, badges, and invalid form fields.

tokens.name: color.status.danger.default
tokens.description: Danger/destructive status hue for icons, solid fills, and destructive controls; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

tokens.name: color.status.danger.emphasis
tokens.description: Stronger danger hue for hover/active states of solid danger fills (e.g. danger Button hover); AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

tokens.name: color.status.danger.surface
tokens.description: Tinted background for danger alerts and badges.

tokens.name: color.status.danger.text
tokens.description: Text on color.status.danger.surface and for inline error messages; the pair is AA-checked at build time.

tokens.name: color.status.info.border
tokens.description: Border for informational alerts and badges.

tokens.name: color.status.info.default
tokens.description: Informational status hue for icons and solid fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

tokens.name: color.status.info.emphasis
tokens.description: Stronger informational hue for hover/active states of solid info fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

tokens.name: color.status.info.surface
tokens.description: Tinted background for informational alerts and badges.

tokens.name: color.status.info.text
tokens.description: Text on color.status.info.surface; the pair is AA-checked at build time.

tokens.name: color.status.success.border
tokens.description: Border for success alerts and badges.

tokens.name: color.status.success.default
tokens.description: Success status hue for icons and solid fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

tokens.name: color.status.success.emphasis
tokens.description: Stronger success hue for hover/active states of solid success fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

tokens.name: color.status.success.surface
tokens.description: Tinted background for success alerts and badges.

tokens.name: color.status.success.text
tokens.description: Text on color.status.success.surface; the pair is AA-checked at build time.

tokens.name: color.status.warning.border
tokens.description: Border for warning alerts and badges.

tokens.name: color.status.warning.default
tokens.description: Warning status hue for icons and solid fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

tokens.name: color.status.warning.emphasis
tokens.description: Stronger warning hue for hover/active states of solid warning fills; AA-checked against color.text.inverse.

tokens.name: color.status.warning.surface
tokens.description: Tinted background for warning alerts and badges.

tokens.name: color.status.warning.text
tokens.description: Text on color.status.warning.surface; the pair is AA-checked at build time.

tokens.name: color.surface.default
tokens.description: Default page and application background; the base layer every view starts from.

tokens.name: color.surface.inverse
tokens.description: High-contrast dark surface for inverted regions such as tooltips and dark banners. Pair text with color.text.inverse.

tokens.name: color.surface.overlay
tokens.description: Base color for modal backdrops and scrims. Components apply their own opacity on top of this color; it is not a text background.

tokens.name: color.surface.raised
tokens.description: Background for content lifted above the page — cards, menus, popovers, dialogs. Pair with shadow.raised or shadow.overlay.

tokens.name: color.surface.sunken
tokens.description: Recessed background for wells, inset panels, code blocks, and zebra stripes that sit visually below the default surface.

tokens.name: color.surface.sunken-hover
tokens.description: Hover/pressed step for interactive sunken surfaces, e.g. the Switch off-state track under the pointer. One ramp step darker than color.surface.sunken; not a text background.

tokens.name: color.text.inverse
tokens.description: Text used on color.surface.inverse and other dark regions such as tooltips.

tokens.name: color.text.link
tokens.description: Inline hyperlink color; AA-checked on default, raised, and sunken surfaces.

tokens.name: color.text.muted
tokens.description: De-emphasized text for placeholders, hints, and metadata. The lightest text color that remains AA on all light surfaces.

tokens.name: color.text.on-accent
tokens.description: Text and icon color for accent-filled controls; AA-checked against color.accent.default and color.accent.emphasis.

tokens.name: color.text.primary
tokens.description: Primary reading color for body copy and headings on default, raised, and sunken surfaces.

tokens.name: color.text.secondary
tokens.description: Supporting text — descriptions, captions, secondary labels. Lower emphasis than primary while staying AA on all light surfaces.

tokens.name: font.family.mono
tokens.description: Monospace stack for code, tabular numbers, and technical identifiers.

tokens.name: font.family.sans
tokens.description: Default typeface stack for all UI text and body copy.

tokens.name: motion.duration.fast
tokens.description: Micro-interactions: hovers, toggles, small fades.

tokens.name: motion.duration.normal
tokens.description: Default duration for most transitions: dropdowns, tooltips, tab switches.

tokens.name: motion.duration.slow
tokens.description: Large-surface transitions: dialogs, drawers, page-level changes.

tokens.name: motion.easing.enter
tokens.description: Decelerating easing for elements entering the screen.

tokens.name: motion.easing.exit
tokens.description: Accelerating easing for elements leaving the screen.

tokens.name: motion.easing.standard
tokens.description: Default easing for on-screen state changes; starts and ends gently.

tokens.name: radius.full
tokens.description: Fully rounded corners for pills, badges, and circular controls.

tokens.name: radius.lg
tokens.description: Large corner radius for cards, dialogs, and prominent containers.

tokens.name: radius.md
tokens.description: Default corner radius for buttons, alerts, and mid-size containers.

tokens.name: radius.sm
tokens.description: Small corner radius for compact controls: inputs, checkboxes, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow.focus-ring
tokens.description: Focus ring rendered as a box-shadow halo in a light accent tint; combine with color.border.focus on the element edge.

tokens.name: shadow.overlay
tokens.description: Highest elevation for dialogs and overlays that block the page.

tokens.name: shadow.raised
tokens.description: Low elevation for content raised above the page: cards, menus, popovers. Pair with color.surface.raised.

tokens.name: size.control.lg
tokens.description: Height of large interactive controls for prominent actions (12x the brand space base).

tokens.name: size.control.md
tokens.description: Default height of interactive controls: buttons, inputs, and selects (10x the brand space base).

tokens.name: size.control.sm
tokens.description: Height of small interactive controls: compact buttons, inputs, and selects (8x the brand space base).

tokens.name: size.icon.lg
tokens.description: Icon and spinner size for prominent controls, empty states, and alerts (6x the brand space base). Use this — never a space token — to size an element.

tokens.name: size.icon.md
tokens.description: Default icon and spinner size alongside body text and inside md controls (5x the brand space base). Use this — never a space token — to size an element.

tokens.name: size.icon.sm
tokens.description: Icon and spinner size inside compact controls and dense UI (4x the brand space base). Use this — never a space token — to size an element.

tokens.name: space.0
tokens.description: Zero space; use to state 'no gap' explicitly instead of a raw 0 with units.

tokens.name: space.1
tokens.description: Space step 1 (1x the brand space base); tightest gap, e.g. icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space.10
tokens.description: Space step 10 (16x the brand space base); the largest layout separation.

tokens.name: space.2
tokens.description: Space step 2 (2x the brand space base); compact padding and small gaps.

tokens.name: space.3
tokens.description: Space step 3 (3x the brand space base); default control padding.

tokens.name: space.4
tokens.description: Space step 4 (4x the brand space base); default gap between related elements.

tokens.name: space.5
tokens.description: Space step 5 (5x the brand space base); padding for medium containers.

tokens.name: space.6
tokens.description: Space step 6 (6x the brand space base); padding for large containers and section gaps.

tokens.name: space.7
tokens.description: Space step 7 (8x the brand space base); separation between content groups.

tokens.name: space.8
tokens.description: Space step 8 (10x the brand space base); separation between major regions.

tokens.name: space.9
tokens.description: Space step 9 (12x the brand space base); large layout separation.

tokens.name: space.gap.lg
tokens.description: Large flex/grid gap between loosely related groups (4x the brand space base).

tokens.name: space.gap.md
tokens.description: Default flex/grid gap between sibling elements (2x the brand space base).

tokens.name: space.gap.sm
tokens.description: Small flex/grid gap for tightly related items (1x the brand space base).

tokens.name: space.inset.lg
tokens.description: Generous uniform internal padding for large containers (6x the brand space base).

tokens.name: space.inset.md
tokens.description: Default uniform internal padding for containers (4x the brand space base).

tokens.name: space.inset.sm
tokens.description: Small uniform internal padding for compact containers (2x the brand space base).

tokens.name: text.leading.loose
tokens.description: Airy line height for long-form reading and spacious layouts.

tokens.name: text.leading.normal
tokens.description: Default line height for body copy and multi-line text.

tokens.name: text.leading.tight
tokens.description: Compact line height for headings and single-line controls.

tokens.name: text.size.2xl
tokens.description: Page headings; step +3 on the brand modular scale.

tokens.name: text.size.3xl
tokens.description: Display and hero headings; step +4 on the brand modular scale.

tokens.name: text.size.lg
tokens.description: Emphasized body text and small headings; step +1 on the brand modular scale.

tokens.name: text.size.md
tokens.description: Base body size for paragraphs, labels, and control text; step 0 (the brand type-scale base).

tokens.name: text.size.sm
tokens.description: Secondary text and dense UI such as table cells and helper text; step -1 on the brand modular scale.

tokens.name: text.size.xl
tokens.description: Section headings and dialog titles; step +2 on the brand modular scale.

tokens.name: text.size.xs
tokens.description: Smallest legible size for fine print, badges, and dense metadata; step -2 on the brand modular scale.

tokens.name: text.weight.bold
tokens.description: Highest emphasis; reserve for display headings and critical highlights.

tokens.name: text.weight.medium
tokens.description: Slight emphasis for control labels, buttons, and selected items.

tokens.name: text.weight.regular
tokens.description: Default weight for body copy and most UI text.

tokens.name: text.weight.semibold
tokens.description: Headings and strong inline emphasis.

tokens.name: z.dropdown
tokens.description: Stacking layer for dropdown and select popovers. Fixed ordering: dropdown < sticky < overlay < toast < tooltip.

tokens.name: z.overlay
tokens.description: Stacking layer for modal dialogs and their backdrops. Fixed ordering: dropdown < sticky < overlay < toast < tooltip.

tokens.name: z.toast
tokens.description: Stacking layer for toasts and transient notifications. Fixed ordering: dropdown < sticky < overlay < toast < tooltip.

tokens.name: z.tooltip
tokens.description: Topmost stacking layer, for tooltips. Fixed ordering: dropdown < sticky < overlay < toast < tooltip.
